metadata.value: Probably acquired in Poland (Lodz) in 1927 (letter from Benjamin Balslev to the University Librarian, 1927-05-28). Preservation work (cleaning and mounting) by the Royal Library's Department of Preservation, 2002. ; Amulet for a woman (after child-birth?) ; Oriental (?) ; Square and cursive script; with tagin ; Jansson, Eva-Maria: "Three Amulets in Copenhagen" Verbum et Calamus [FS Harviainen], ed. Juusola, Laulainen and Palva, Helsinki 2004, pp. 93-105
